task.title: Paginate customer search results
task.objective: Add optional pagination to customer search.
acceptance_criteria: Clients can request a bounded page of customer results.
Requests without pagination retain their existing behavior.

assessment.rationale: The change spans the query and API layers and requires compatibility checks.

plan.approach: Add bounded queries first, then expose pagination through optional request parameters.

work_units.objective: Add deterministic paging to customer queries.
acceptance: Consecutive pages return ordered results without duplicates.

work_units.objective: Expose and validate optional pagination parameters.
acceptance: Requests without pagination keep their existing response behavior.

verification: Run customer query and controller tests.
Verify existing search clients can omit pagination parameters.
